title: Evaluating the Effects of EHRs, P4P and Medical Home Redesign in the Hudson Valley
brief_summary: The investigators will conduct a longitudinal cohort study with concurrent controls. The investigators will include all primary care physicians in the Hudson Valley including family practitioners, internists, and pediatricians. The purpose of this study is to determine the effects of implementing electronic health records (EHRs), pay-for-performance incentives for physicians (P4P), and Medical Home redesign on health care quality, cost and patient experience in the Hudson Valley.
raw_criteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

* Primary care physicians working in the offices practices in the Hudson Valley, and who are members of the Taconic IPA.

Exclusion Criteria:

* Physicians who opt out from the study.
study_population: All primary care physicians (i.e. general internists, pediatricians and family practice physicians) in the Hudson Valley who are members of the Taconic Independent Practice Association (IPA).
